data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'albus' meaning 'white', Alurta is a name of noble and strong character. In Christian tradition, it is associated with purity and innocence. The name Alurta carries the meaning “Strong, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alurta usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
